BranchCondition.description: Branch/loop condition: expression text + operand refs where recoverable (§7).
BranchCondition.title: BranchCondition

CalleeUnboundReason.description:
Why a call node's target has no interior in the graph (§5.4.2 T5).

These are *not* failures to report as errors. A Lombok accessor has no
source body by construction; a JDK method is not the system's code. The
reason exists so a consumer can render "no source to analyse, because X"
rather than a node that dead-ends for no stated cause — which is
indistinguishable from a hole in the map, and is what made a correct
extraction read as data loss (P10).
CalleeUnboundReason.title: CalleeUnboundReason

EntityAccess.description:
One entity one call site touches, with one operation (§5.2.17).

``candidate_operation`` is evidence, never a claim (R1-11): it is the verb
a gated basis computed while its flag was off. The fact then publishes
``create-or-update``, and a reader that wants the claim reads
``operation`` only.

candidate_operation.description: The verb a gated basis would have claimed (create | update); set only on a demoted fact, whose operation is then create-or-update

data_model_id.description: The entity's `dm_` id when the entity is in this service's data_models
data_model_id.title: Data Model Id

entity.description: Qualified type name of the entity; None = the entity could not be determined (an unbindable repository chain or an unresolved query name)
entity.title: Entity

EntityAccess.title: EntityAccess

EntityAccessBasis.description: Which evidence decided a site's operations (§5.2.17).
EntityAccessBasis.title: EntityAccessBasis

EntityAccessSite.description:
One repository call site and what it touches (§5.2.17, E1, C1).

Carried on the ICFG node of the statement that makes the call, as a list,
because one statement can make two repository calls (R1-2). Sites are
counted as sites and accesses as accesses, never mixed: a query that
deletes ``Invoice`` while reading ``Customer`` is ONE site with TWO
accesses.

entity_type_text.description: The repository's entity type argument as written, kept as raw evidence when it could not be resolved to a type (R1-4)
entity_type_text.title: Entity Type Text

repository.description: The receiver's declared repository type, qualified, e.g. 'com.acme.pets.PetRepository'
repository.title: Repository

EntityAccessSite.title: EntityAccessSite

EntityOperation.description:
What an access may do to its entity (§5.2.17).

"May" is the whole meaning: some path through the endpoint performs it,
never that every path does (Q16). The vocabulary is CRUD because the
reader is a developer; there is no ``write``.
EntityOperation.title: EntityOperation

back.description: Cycle-closing loop edge (§5.2.8); orthogonal to kind (do-while: true+back)
back.title: Back

case_values.description: Stacked case labels on a `case` edge (source text of each value); empty on every other kind (§5.2.8).
case_values.title: Case Values

IcfgEdgeKind.description:
Intra-method flow labels plus interprocedural call/return.

1.8.0 (§5.2.8): ``case``/``default`` (switch selector → arm, case values on
the edge), ``fallthrough`` (case body → next arm), and ``exception``
(try-tail → catch handler) gain writers; cycle-closing loop edges carry the
edge-level ``back`` flag rather than a kind of their own (an edge can be
both a ``true`` body edge and a back edge — do-while).
IcfgEdgeKind.title: IcfgEdgeKind

callee_unbound_reason.description: Why this call's target has no interior in the graph (§5.4.2 T5): lombok-generated | inherited-external | compiler-generated | third-party | ambiguous-overload | unresolved-receiver. The node is ALWAYS kept — a call with no visible body still runs — so this is what lets a consumer say 'no source to analyse' instead of rendering a silent dead end (P10). None = the callee is in this graph, or the artifact predates 1.12.0 (unknown, not 'bound').

construct_kind.description: Which Java construct this node is (§5.2.8): if | switch | switch-arrow | for | foreach | while | do-while | try | catch | finally | throw | break | continue | goto. None = plain statement or an artifact predating 1.8.0 (unknown, not 'statement' — P10). (Named construct_kind because pydantic reserves `construct`.)
construct_kind.title: Construct Kind

entity_access_sites.description: 1.26.0 (§5.2.17): one entry per repository call this statement makes — a list, as `remote_call_ids` is, because one statement can make two (R1-2). Empty on every other node, and on graphs written before 1.26.0; read the endpoint's `entity_access` to tell those apart
entity_access_sites.title: Entity Access Sites

remote_call_id.description: DEPRECATED (since 1.1.0): first entry of remote_call_ids, kept for readers predating multi-candidate URL slicing. Prefer remote_call_ids.
remote_call_id.title: Remote Call Id

remote_call_ids.description: All RemoteCall facts at this call site — one per sliced candidate URL (§5.2 over-approximation). Order matches the export.
remote_call_ids.title: Remote Call Ids

source_text.description: The node's one-line source text (graph labels are real code)
source_text.title: Source Text

MethodInfo.description: Carried by method entry nodes: signature, typing, docs, behavior badges (§7).

badges.description: Derived behavior badges from tags, e.g. 'touches-db', 'calls-http'
badges.title: Badges

MethodInfo.title: MethodInfo

MethodRef.description: Reference to a method: stable content-derived id + human-readable signature.
MethodRef.title: MethodRef

OperandRef.description: A structured reference to one operand of a branch condition.
OperandRef.title: OperandRef

SinkKind.description: Sink classification mirroring the ``sink=`` tag namespace.
SinkKind.title: SinkKind

SourceAnchor.description:
A file + line range in the text that was actually analyzed.

For preprocessed files (delombok) the anchor refers to the generated
variant — source-on-demand serves that same text, so anchors and served
source stay aligned by construction (§5.3).

file.description: Path relative to the service build root
file.title: File

SourceAnchor.title: SourceAnchor

SourceVariant.description:
Whether an anchor refers to original repo text or a generated variant (§5.3).

``GENERATED`` marks preprocessor output (e.g. delombok'ed Java) — the text
that was actually analyzed, served by source-on-demand with a badge.
SourceVariant.title: SourceVariant

description:
The assembled ICFG of one endpoint (statement-granularity, coarsened).

The root is *explicit* (``entry_node_id``), never inferred from topology:
a recursive flow back into the handler would give the root incoming
edges, so "the entry with no incoming edges" is not a sound definition.

entry_node_id.description: The endpoint handler's entry node (explicit root)
entry_node_id.title: Entry Node Id

title: Icfg
